name: Riemann hypothesis
target: All nontrivial zeros of zeta have real part 1/2
barriers: no zero-free region reaches Re s = 1/2
the quasi-Riemann hypothesis (OpenAI family 003, unrefereed) clears only Re s > 7/8; the strip 1/2 < Re s <= 7/8 is untouched
proportion results (Alpoge-Furman arXiv:2608.13637, Lamzouri arXiv:2609.02882: at least 0.6725 of the zeros simple and on the line) cannot exclude a set of density zero off the line
the Uniform Collar Bound E_2(X,H) << X^(2+eps)/H is false: E_2 is about XH, and at X = 4e6, H = X^0.8 the bound is too small by a factor 8498
Nyman-Beurling completeness over the integer dilations is equivalent to the hypothesis itself
a claimed bound on the Liouville correlations below the random-model size sqrt(X) per shift is rejected (ebllm.bllm.screens)
